title: Verify review-lens v2 migration — run SPEC suite and close any gaps
goal: Confirm the committed review-lens v2 migration satisfies all acceptance SPECs (SPEC-1 through SPEC-19); fix any gap found before the PR is opened.

steps.description: Run `npm test` (or the targeted review-lens test script directly) to establish which of SPEC-1 through SPEC-19 pass and which fail. This is the gating step — all 19 must be green. Any failing SPEC pinpoints the exact gap addressed in subsequent contingency steps.

Contingency — if SPEC-4 or SPEC-5 fail: verify `_llm_envelope_parse --schema-gate _review_lens_envelope_schema_ok` is the parse call at ~line 332 of plugin.sh and that `_review_lens_envelope_schema_ok` validates `.findings | type == "array"`. Fix if missing or incorrect. Mirrors security-lens pattern (ADR-028 §Migration, #2035).

Contingency — if SPEC-1, SPEC-2, SPEC-3, SPEC-13, or SPEC-15 fail: verify `_review_lens_write_result` writes {result_contract:2, verdict, disposition, reason} and is called on every terminal exit path — router failure, unparseable reply, normalization failure, rc=130 (interrupted), and rc=10 (exhausted). Fix any mis-wired or missing branch.

Contingency — if SPEC-14 fails: verify `_review_lens_budget_guidance` and `_review_lens_wallclock_guidance` are sourced from `_route_resolve_max_turns` / `_route_resolve_timeout` respectively (not hand-copied literals) and their output is appended to the prompt before `route_to_model`. Fix sourcing or call-site if wrong.

Contingency — if SPEC-7, SPEC-12, SPEC-16, SPEC-17, SPEC-18, or SPEC-19 fail: apply the missing manifest field(s) — result_contract:2, valid_verdicts, primary:true on lens_result, provides.events (exactly 3), provides.role:review_lens, inputs with only id+required (no path/type/producer_stage), hooks.cleanup absent with ADR-054 §7 comment.

Contingency — if SPEC-11 or SPEC-10 fail: verify (a) `_review_lens_write_result` body contains no hardcoded artifact filename literals; (b) no merge-action coercion tokens appear in plugin.sh or lib/charters.sh. Fix any violation.

Run `npm test` a final time to confirm all SPEC-1 through SPEC-19 assertions are green with the tree committed first (so the mutation tier engages). Satisfies DoD `npm test green` and `reddens at merge-base` requirements.

notes: The implementation is fully committed on branch zbuild/issue-1840-ci. manifest.yaml (94 lines): result_contract:2, valid_verdicts:[complete,degraded], provides.role:review_lens, provides.events (3 events: review_lens.failed, review_lens.redaction_failed, review_lens.unparseable), primary:true on lens_result, config.router.{timeout_s:300, max_turns:10}, inputs with only id+required, no hooks.cleanup with ADR-054 §7 comment. plugin.sh (398 lines): _review_lens_envelope_schema_ok schema gate, _llm_envelope_parse --schema-gate at line 332, _review_lens_write_result on all terminal exit paths, _review_lens_budget_guidance and _review_lens_wallclock_guidance sourced from _route_resolve_max_turns/_route_resolve_timeout, _review_lens_interrupt_handler trap registered. tests (912 lines): SPEC-1 through SPEC-19 covering all acceptance criteria. Steps 2-6 are contingency-only; estimated_lines reflects gap-filling budget, not new code. The 'reddens at merge-base' criterion is structurally satisfied: SPEC-7 through SPEC-19 assert v2 fields absent from the pre-migration codebase. No template modification step is included because review-lens is convergence:advisory and the issue body grants no latitude to add it to a live flow — the issue states the engine reads v1 and v2 side by side and this plugin moves on its own. The shared reply parser (#2035) and budget block (#2032) items are already landed in plugin.sh per prior exploration. lib/charters.sh assumption: contains no coercion tokens; SPEC-10 grep assertion in the test file catches any violation at step-1.
